h: Sunday night, and the shop's already mapped for the week. 🌙
t: Boxes are sorted, the show piles are set, and the week ahead already knows what it's doing. Sunday's the quiet night — the one where the work is just putting everything back where…

h: Five days out, and the singles are already getting pulled. 🎴
t: Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM CT — the big Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles, and the countdown to 1,000 orders is still running. The show piles are where the small stuff goes…

h: Every card that comes in gets one of three doors. 🚪
t: Dupes and anything 20 bucks and up — eBay. The small stuff — Whatnot piles. The rest — binder, box, or the "not yet" stack. No card sits in limbo wondering where it belongs.…

h: No scanner. Just my phone and good light. 📱
t: Every card in the store got pictured the same way — front, back, flat, in daylight. No fancy rig, no $300 scanner sitting on the desk. The trick is boring: clean background,…

h: Nothing in my store lists under $2.96. Not one card. 💰
t: That's not a random number — it's the math. Fees eat anything cheaper, and a card that sells for less than it costs to list, pack, and ship is a card that loses money standing…

h: Every card leaves here in the same build. 📦
t: Penny sleeve. Semi-rigid card saver — not a top loader. Team bag. Mailer. Top loaders are for 20 bucks and up, in a bubble mailer with cardboard. Everything else rides the same…
